visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair sits on a grey fabric sofa, holding up a white tank top followed by a black zippered hoodie and black denim shorts. The setting is a brightly lit indoor living room. (3) A close-up view shows her hands using blue-handled scissors to carefully snip the fingertips off black cloth gloves. (4) Transition to the woman fully dressed in the cosplay outfit (cat ears, white top, hoodie), sitting on the sofa and posing with a smartphone. (5) A full-screen digital illustration of the silver-haired game character Silver Wolf is displayed. (6) Back on the sofa, she wears a white graphic t-shirt and displays a large black witch hat with lace trim. (7) She is shown pulling on tall black leather boots and then posing while wearing the witch hat and a black coat over her shoulders. (8) Full-frame digital art of a witch-like character in purple is shown. (9) She shows a silver tiara and a cone of flowers containing pink, white, and yellow blossoms while wearing a white t-shirt. (10) She poses in a white lace outfit, holding the flower bouquet and smiling. (11) Digital art of a character in a garden with butterflies is shown. (12) She sits on the sofa, holding the flowers close to her face and speaking directly to the viewer with a friendly expression.
